entity.description:
Although Batman possesses no superhuman powers, he is one of the world's smartest men and one of its greatest fighters. His physical prowess and technical ingenuity make him an incredibly dangerous opponent. He is also a founding member of the Justice League and the Outsiders. Batman fights with a wide range of sidekicks and partners such as Robin and Batgirl.

There have been times in which the mantle of Batman have been passed on and used by others, those are:

Batman was created by writer Bill Finger and artist Bob Kane, first appearing in (1939). Since then, Batman has been one of the most well-known DC Comics characters alongside Superman and Wonder Woman throughout his entire comics publication history and also in other media. This also extends to both his supporting cast and his rogues gallery, particularly his arch-enemy the Joker.
